title: Critique: a small palette cannot yield the range of experienced qualities

statements.text: Human experience holds a vast array of colors, sounds, smells and tastes. If Russellian panpsychism is right there are only a handful of microqualities, one per fundamental physical property, and they seem too few to constitute that range.

sources.quote: How can this limited palette of microqualities combine to yield the vast array of macroqualities?
Macrophenomenal qualities are too diverse to be constituted by a few microphenomenal qualities.
